facts.text: In 1905 the Duke of San Pedro de Galatino decided to build the hotel, then called The Hotel Casino Alhambra Palace.
facts.excerpt: In 1905, over a century ago, an idealistic and romantic man fell in love with the fascinating city of Granada and decided—with all the confidence and the tenacity of a lover—to build The Hotel Casino Alhambra Palace.

facts.text: The hotel was created by the Duke of San Pedro de Galatino.
facts.excerpt: The story of a visionary, the Duke of San Pedro de Galatino

facts.text: The building has a 'galatea orange' hue from the colour of iron-rich earth that shifts with the time of day, resembling the nearby Alhambra.
facts.excerpt: With its unique "galatea orange" hue provided by the colour of the iron-rich earth, it shows different chromatic variations depending on the time of day, resembling the majestic Alhambra nearby.

facts.text: The exterior has a crenelated, curvilinear design likened to the walls of Avila.
facts.excerpt: Outwardly, its crenelated and curvilinear design has an unmistakable likeness to the Avila´s wall: strong, robust,and not excessively tall.

facts.text: The interior is neo-Moorish, with mirrors, mosaics, muqarnas and arches.
facts.excerpt: The entire interior of the Alhambra Palace Hotel is pure embellishment: the neo-Moorish style abounds with splashes of mirrors, mosaics, muqarnas and arches.

facts.text: El Teatrillo, the hotel's Little Theater, stands where the duke's casino once was.
facts.excerpt: el Teatrillo, the “Little Theater” of the palace the place where the casino, dearly loved by the duke, once stood

facts.text: El Teatrillo's size suits chamber music, solo recitals and small performances.
facts.excerpt: Its size makes it ideal for chamber music, solo recitals, and small performances.

facts.text: In June 1922 the theater hosted the 'Concurso del Cante Jondo' flamenco song contest.
facts.excerpt: In June 1922, a flamenco song contest was held in this theater called “El concurso del cante jondo” (the contest of the deep song).

facts.text: During the Civil War the hotel served as a field hospital for three years, and it reopened in 1942.
facts.excerpt: The Widowed Duchess, Mrs. Fernanda De Salabert Y Arteaga, Donates the Hotel and It Becomes a Field Hospital for Three Years.

facts.text: Red crosses painted on the roof saved the building from aerial bombardment.
facts.excerpt: The Roof of the Building is Painted With Red Crosses. This Saved the Building From Aerial Bombardment.

facts.text: Since the early 1980s the duke's heirs have managed the hotel directly.
facts.excerpt: At the beginning of the 80s of the last century, the heirs of the duke of San Pedro de Galatino took over the management of the hotel directly

facts.text: The hotel has hosted travellers, aristocrats, royalty and artists from around the world.
facts.excerpt: The Hotel's Style Attracts Travellers, Aristocrats, Royalty and Artists From All Over the World Looking for a Place to Dream.

facts.text: The hotel is at Plaza Arquitecto Garcia de Paredes 1 in Granada.
facts.excerpt: Domicilio Social: Plaza Arquitecto Garcia De Paredes Nº1, Cp 18.009 Granada ( España)

facts.text: The New Year's Eve 2026 gala dinner is exclusively for guests staying at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The gala dinner is **exclusively for guests staying at the hotel**, accommodation is not included.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself the icon of luxury tourism in Granada.
facts.excerpt: Hotel Alhambra Palace, the icon of luxury tourism in Granada
